## Public Safety Checklist

- [ ] I did not commit real secrets, tokens, passwords, private keys, customer
      data, provider account identifiers, or private deployment material.
- [ ] Generated configs, local env files, Wrangler outputs, Terraform state,
      database dumps, and local cache files are excluded or scrubbed.
- [ ] Screenshots, logs, fixtures, and docs do not expose cookies, auth headers,
      private URLs, personal email addresses, internal IDs, or local paths.
- [ ] Any new environment values are documented with placeholders in
      `*.example` files, not real values.
